name: Sunken Relief
description: Designs carved inward below a flat surface. Often used for glyphs, stone engraving, or fossil-style aesthetics.
carving_traits: Requires inversion of typical heightmap logic
Works well with stylized linework or hieroglyphics
machinability_prompt: Create a grayscale heightmap where the design is carved inward. White indicates flat surface, black is maximum depth. All carving should recess from a flat background. No shading, lighting, or color.
